changeSet.sql:
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Resource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ApiReadOnlyAccessToken') begin if exists (select sdc.name from sys.default_constraints sdc where object_name(sdc.parent_object_id) = 'Resource' and sdc.name = 'DF_Resource_ApiReadOnlyAccessCode' ) begin alter table [dbo].[Resource] DROP CONSTRAINT DF_Resource_ApiReadOnlyAccessCode; end
alter table [dbo].[Resource] drop column [ApiReadOnlyAccessToken] end
changeSet.rollback:
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Resource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ApiReadOnlyAccessToken') begin alter table [dbo].[Resource] add [ApiReadOnlyAccessToken] [varchar](50)
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Resource] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_Resource_ApiReadOnlyAccessCode] DEFAULT ([dbo].[GenerateReadOnlyAccessToken]()) FOR [ApiReadOnlyAccessToken] end
